body.focus: Defect: the signed macOS legacy cutover refuses a running aaae72fd7 daemon started with Node 26.5.1 and --import tsx/esm because its long-lived esbuild service child references the legacy checkout. Reproduced in disposable VM and matching child observed on host. Keep unrelated process rejection and verify a pinned predecessor-owned helper exits during drain before activation. Add targeted coverage and rerun the isolated signed source migration.
body.summary: Story source commit d02fb640882dd3a89840871d1631398f6b69c8e4 contains all three implementation/test paths and the Insrc-Story trailer. Inspect that commit's changes with git show and compare to its parent 733f0077ff7f3fa7c9d772e5a850719c9ec7c9c8. The earlier 85dcca940 is the pre-build baseline; unrelated dirty ISSUE and scratchpad docs predate this task. Local typecheck and five native cutover/run-guard tests passed.
